text:
maria: Quick heads-up — embeddings service in eu-west1 is returning intermittent 503s after the quant rollout. Suspect the quant execution path. Need an expedited hotfix + canary pin. Ops + release signoff ideally in the next 20m.
aj: on it. paste the exact commit and rollback criteria?
sam: +1 to hotfix. if canary looks clean we can promote fast.
nate: recommend canary traffic: 5% -> wait 10m -> 25% -> promote. Alert thresholds: lower latency alarm and error rate watch.
maria: commit: `c3a7f9d` (cherry-pick). rollback criteria: sustained error rate >1% for 3m OR 5xx spike >50 req/min OR p90 latency >200ms for 5m.
deploy-bot: @maria acknowledged. Preparing image tag `embeds-hotfix-c3a7f9d`.
ross: Release notes blurb for PR:
```
Hotfix (eu-west1 embeddings): Revert a quant micro-optimization causing intermittent 503s. Cherry-pick commit c3a7f9d. No schema changes. Expected impact: reduce failed inference errors. Promote after canary passes.
```
maria: kicking off deploy: `deploybot start --svc=embeddings --region=eu-west1 --image=embeds-hotfix-c3a7f9d --canary=5% --notify=eng-releases,ops-oncall`
ops-oncall: watching from pager channel https://pager.company/incident/78321. I'll escalate if rollback criteria hit.
aj: I approve expedited push. :thumbsup: 
sam: approved. Added release notes PR: https://git.company/release-notes/pulls/4127
deploy-bot: Canary roll started — embeddings eu-west1 @ 5% (image embeds-hotfix-c3a7f9d). Health checks passing on primaries, readiness probes OK.
maria: running smoke tests — simple inference returned 200 OK and embedding length ~153, samples look valid.
nate: telemetry: seeing a small dip in p95 latency, errors trending down. hold for 10m before bumping to 25%.
(monitoring): alert rule: embeddings-eu-5xx firing if >10/min — currently 3/min.
--- 10m later ---
maria: canary stable at 5% for 10m. no error spikes. propose bumping to 25% now.
aj: approve bump. go for 25%.
deploy-bot: Canary updated to 25%.
ops-oncall: still watching. no pager escalations. keeping burn window for 30m post-promote.
--- 30m later ---
maria: 25% stable for 20m, no regressions. Promoting to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Promotion started — rolling image embeds-hotfix-c3a7f9d to 100% in eu-west1.
ross: tagging release notes PR with timestamp and ops contact.
ops-oncall: marking incident resolved if no regressions in next 1h. good job team :tada:
end.
